metadata.description: Sujeet's marketplace exposing the adk plugin (Agent Development Kit). The default 'adk' entry tracks the latest commit on the main branch on GitHub. The 'adk-npm' entry installs the published npm package and lets you pin to a specific version.

plugins.name: adk
plugins.description: Agent Development Kit - 50+ composable skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers, and monitors for the developer loop, optimized for Claude Code. Default install: tracks the latest commit on the main branch and refreshes on /plugin marketplace update.

plugins.name: adk-npm
plugins.description: Same ADK plugin, installed from the npm registry as 'agents-devkit'. Use this when you want to pin to a specific semver version (set version constraints via /plugin install) instead of always tracking the main branch.
